What it will draw: a power estimate from the resource count

The compiler also estimates power. Set how many LUTs, flip-flops, block RAMs and DSPs a design uses, the clock and the toggle rate, and read each part of the estimate in milliwatts.

This page sets no cookie and sends nothing anywhere.
